from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenueRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the operating revenue reported by a single company for the relevant period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the document")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="The reported operating revenue amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the revenue figure (e.g., 'CNY', 'Yuan')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for which revenue is disclosed")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_revenue_records: list[CompanyRevenueRecord]
